features.title: AI retreat and regrouping
features.originalRequirement: opponents preserve troops and return with reinforcements.
features.coveredBehavior: A wounded fighter receives a real retreat order and remains in retreat while a paid recruit trains. After simulation advances and the reinforcement reaches the rally, the retreat record is released and the recruit is at the same rally. Dead recruits and raised units cannot satisfy regrouping; observed numerical threat causes withdrawal.

passedCases.fullName: AI modes in the running simulation retreats wounded troops, waits for a newly trained reinforcement, then returns them to the army
AI modes in the running simulation keeps retreating soldiers at the rally when a paid reinforcement dies before regrouping

AI modes in the running simulation withdraws from a visible outnumbered fight while ignoring a large hidden army

features.limits: This proves preservation and regroup/reintegration with a real paid reinforcement. The focused case does not assert a later renewed enemy attack; architecture's full renewed-attack scenario is stronger than the original clause. Current native terminal equality does not prove advancing retreat continuation.
